item.title: Panthers of the Week: Bryce Riggs, Meechie White
item.description: The first Panther of the Week is going to Bryce Riggs from the baseball team. item.title: Sankofa Awards to replace annual Miss Black EIU pageant
item.description: Miss Black EIU is cancelled this year due to low contestant interest, with only one student interested in competing, according to EIU Black Student Union adviser Ariel Taylor. item.title: Mattoon insurance agency celebrates 80th anniversary
item.description: The Gardner-Whitworth Insurance Agency in Mattoon is celebrating its 80th anniversary in 2026 after years of providing insurance to the area. item.title: CHS boys’ basketball falls to Mattoon on senior night
item.description: A barrage of three pointers from Mattoon ballooned a 16-point halftime lead to as much as 29 in the third quarter, spoiling the Trojans’ senior night with Charleston falling 66-32 to Mattoon Tuesday at Baker Gym. item.title: COLUMN: EIU’s first Black athlete, WWII hero deserves recognition
item.description: One of EIU’s most impactful famous alums has basically no recognition anywhere on campus. I think it’s time to change that. Charles Blakesly Hall was a student at what is now Eastern Illinois University from 1938 until he dropped to join the war effort in the spring of 1941.
